messages:
Gia (People Ops): quick heads-up  we've pushed a concise update to the Hybrid Work policy in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/hybrid-work. Key bits below.
Gia (People Ops): TL;DR: core office day requirement reduced to 1 day/week (team-determined), focused on collaboration weeks (first full week of month), mandatory safety + data-handling microlearning for any office day, and new desk-booking defaults.
Marcus (Facilities): note: desk booking now has a new grace window (6hr before start) and auto-release at 11:59pm local if unused. We also tightened capacity limits for HQ on major event days.
Diego (Eng): do core days have to be the same every week? some teams rotate.
Gia (People Ops): teams can pick a consistent weekly day or use a rotating cadence. If you opt for rotation, please note it in the team sheet so ownership knows where to expect folks.
Lena (People Ops): action: managers, please declare your team's preferred model (fixed weekly day OR rotating) and your primary in-office coordinator in this sheet by EOD Wednesday: https://sheets.redwood.ai/hybrid-models (team, model, primary-coordinator). Reply with "MODEL SET" when done.
Diego (Eng): MODEL SET  marked eng-ops as rotating; coordinator is @nora.eng
Marcus (Facilities): badge access sync: contractor badges will be auto-disabled after 30 days of no office check-ins. If you need a longer contractor window, file an exception to facilities with the tag `contractor-access`.
Gia (People Ops): training: lms-bot will assign "Office Safety & Data Handling" (12 min) to everyone who marks any office day on the sheet. Completion required before the first in-office day.
lms-bot: Assigned course: "Office Safety & Data Handling" to 87 users (marked for in-office days). Due: before first office day. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/office-safety
Marcus (Facilities): if teams need recurring room blocks for weekly syncs please DM me the recurring rule and i'll reserve a suite of rooms. Also: remember to cancel bookings at least 2 hours ahead to free capacity.
Gia (People Ops): question re: hybrid exceptions  can a role be fully remote? policy allows fully remote roles on a case-by-case approval from People Ops + Hiring Manager. Added an exceptions checklist in the handbook.
Diego (Eng): small ops q: will payroll or benefits be affected if someone switches to fully remote (different state)?
Lena (People Ops): cross-state work affects payroll & tax; People Ops + Comp will coordinate for any state-change. Please submit a location-change ticket at: https://tickets.redwood.ai/location-change.
office-bot: Reminder: "Complete Office Safety & Data Handling" will nudge uncompleted users 3 days before required date.
Gia (People Ops): final note: we'll run a compliance check 2 weeks after rollout to ensure teams set their models and that mandatory training is completed. Managers, reply here with "ACK" after you update the sheet.
Diego (Eng): ACK  sheet updated and team informed.
Marcus (Facilities): ACK  will monitor badge metrics and release exceptions log to People Ops weekly.
Lena (People Ops): thanks everyone  short FAQ and a one-page change summary will be posted in #docs shortly. :white_check_mark:
